messages:
rachel: Heads-up: Private autoscale is moving from beta -> GA next week. Posting the GA readiness checklist and a short customer migration playbook now: https://redwood.docs/internal/private-autoscale-ga. Please review if you own docs, support runbooks, or customer comms.

tom: Great. Engineering summary: autoscale uses reserved pool + burst pool. Default policy keeps min_replicas=2 for SLA customers. We're shipping a fix to avoid double-KV invalidation on scale-down (reduces cold-starts).

lena: Compliance note: for Private (VPC/on-prem) customers who require audit logs, enable telemetry-mode: minimal and KMS-integrated logging. We'll include an opt-in toggle in the UI and a customer checklist for SOC2 evidence.

rachel: No pricing changes today, but add an FAQ explaining how burst charges are reported on invoices. Finance will sign off on language by EOD Tuesday.

devops: Ops checklist posted into runbooks: https://redwood.runbooks/private/autoscale. Key items: verify L7 idle timeouts >= 120s, kube-probe timeout < 10s for legacy agents, and network MTU >= 1400 for bulk transfers.

docs-bot: Docs published: private-autoscale-ga/readme.md (v1.0) by rachel

tom: Paste sample config for on-prem teams that hit older kernel timeouts:

```
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 10
  scale_down_delay_seconds: 300
  healthcheck:
    path: /_healthz
    timeout_seconds: 6
  cache:
    prefix_priming: true
    invalidate_on_scale_down: false
```

lena: Also add a short section for customers with HSM-only KMS: note that key wrap latency may add 50-150ms per init call; recommend long-lived sessions where possible.

rachel: Customer comms plan: 1) early-adopter cohort email Wed, 2) webinar Thu (ops + support), 3) general GA announcement next Monday. Marco from sales will own invites.

devops: Deploy triggered: docs->prod (build 20260325.12)

rachel: Action items: @tom confirm KV fix in release notes, @lena finalize SOC2 checklist section, @devops add support routing tag `ga-private-autoscale`. We'll have a 15-min sync tomorrow at 9am PT to finalize templates.

tom: Ack — will add notes and keep the KV-change callout short.

lena: I'll add the evidence table and sample artifact names for auditors.

rachel: Thanks team. If anything blocks GA, ping me directly. :rocket:
